response.justification: Bogdan has extensive backend and distributed systems experience, particularly with microservices, event-driven architectures, and real-time systems at scale (e.g., Dunnhumby, Optilyz). However, his recent AI-agent work is limited to infrastructure and tooling (MCP, code generators) rather than full production multi-agent systems. His fintech experience is minimal, and he lacks leadership in scaling teams to 30+ engineers or governance frameworks for external partners. His strengths in backend systems and observability are offset by gaps in fintech-specific systems and agentic AI architecture.
strengths: Strong backend and distributed-systems expertise with hands-on experience in event-driven architectures and microservices
Production experience with real-time systems and low-latency applications (e.g., Dunnhumby, GISCollective)
Proven ability to architect scalable platforms and developer tooling (e.g., GISCollective, MCP integrations)
concerns: Limited direct experience with multi-agent AI systems in production or fintech-specific applications
Lacks demonstrated leadership in scaling engineering teams to 30+ engineers or managing external delivery partners
Minimal exposure to fintech infrastructure (credit systems, payment flows, regulatory compliance)
